summary: local-data purge --dry-run --json must carry a non-empty action alongside dry_run:true.
reason: The live-dogfood dry-run JSON contract fails any envelope without an action ("empty dry-run action"); the generator's local-data template omits it.
validated_outcome: TestLocalDataPurgeDryRunEnvelope; live gate no longer flags local-data purge json_fidelity.
